album.conflict: There is already a taf at:
album.conflict_hint: Choose another name, or replace it. While it is replaced, a tonie pointing at it plays nothing until the new taf is done.
album.crop_hint: Drag to move, slider or two fingers to zoom.
album.parts_limit: More than {count} tracks do not fit in one.
album.parts_many_minutes: {count} tonies, each its own taf, about {minutes} minutes each.
album.parts_one: One tonie. Long audiobooks are better as parts, each put on by itself.
album.warn.artefact_cover: The only images here are a proof photo or a rip log, not artwork. Check the cover.
album.warn.no_audio: No audio files in this folder.
album.warn.no_cover: No cover image in this folder; upload one.
album.warn.no_titles: No title tags; the track names come from the file names.
albums.intro: Albums are the music as it sits in the archive on the server or in your uploads. Encoding turns one into a taf in the library; a sticker pointing at that taf is what makes it a tonie.
albums.title: Choose an album
assign.duplicate_hint: A second model with the same audio id competes with the first over which name teddyCloud gives a tag on its own. If you want the same content on a second tonie, that is fine - it simply gets two models.
assign.heading: Which tonie?
assign.new_sticker: A new NFC sticker only shows up here once the Toniebox has read it. If yours is missing:
assign.new_tag: New tag seen, loading the list ...
assign.title: Put on a tonie
assign.unknown_tag: The box read a tag that teddyCloud does not know:
assign.unknown_tag_hint: Hold it against the box again, or choose another one below.
backup.contains: A zip file with today's state. It contains:
backup.intro: Everything that makes a tonie and is not in the archive: names, titles, covers, which sticker plays what, playing times and the listening log. The audio is not included; it can be rebuilt from the archive.
backup.not_ours: That zip is not a tonie-studio backup.
backup.not_zip: That is not a zip file.
backup.restore_hint: First comes a preview of what would change; nothing is written until you confirm. Nothing is ever deleted: what exists now and is missing from the backup stays.
backup.too_large: That file is far larger than any backup.
backup.unknown_format: Backup format {format} is not one this app knows.
batch.exists_unused: the taf is already in the library, but no sticker plays it; skipped
batch.exists_used: the taf is already in the library and a sticker plays it; skipped
batch.how: How do the episodes get their stickers?
batch.how_auto: Automatically: the button below puts each album straight onto the free sticker shown next to it, with no further confirmation.
batch.how_place: By placing them: each sticker you then put on the box gets the next episode. That way you know which sticker plays what.
batch.identify: Free stickers look alike: put one on the box and the Tonies page shows what it plays.
batch.intro: Each album is encoded the way its own page suggests: every track except karaoke takes, in the album's order, with the first cover.
batch.progress_intro: The albums run one after another. Each goes onto its sticker as soon as it is done; one without a sticker can be assigned here.
batch.publish_failed: It could not be put on the sticker.

batch.start_assign.one: Encode one album and put it on a sticker
batch.start_assign.other: Encode {count} albums and put them on stickers

batch.start_place.one: Encode one album, then place stickers

batch.tag_taken: The planned sticker has been given something else meanwhile.
batch.title: Several albums

batch.too_few.one: One is needed; the remaining albums are only encoded and can be put on a sticker later.
batch.too_few.other: {count} are needed; the remaining albums are only encoded and can be put on a sticker later.

calibration.hint: Print the calibration sheet once, measure the centre of cross 1 with a ruler and enter it here. It should be {left} mm from the left and {top} mm from the top edge.
calibration.not_shifted: Nothing is moved at the moment.
calibration.saved_hint: Every sheet is moved accordingly from now on.
calibration.shifted: Currently moved {right} mm right and {down} mm down.
calibration.title: Line up the printer
checkup.cloud_fallback: Plays from the library but may ask the Tonies cloud. The box may then try to load content that does not exist there.
checkup.deletes_model: deletes the model {model}; the cover picture stays
checkup.done: Done. The list below has been checked again.
checkup.garbled_model: Name or titles with mangled umlauts. That is how they read in teddyCloud and how they would come out on every printed sticker.
checkup.garbled_path: Points at a path with a mangled umlaut. The box plays nothing. The right taf is in the library.
checkup.healthy_hint: Every tag points at an existing taf, every name is readable, nothing is left over.
checkup.intro: Looks for what is broken before anyone at the box notices: tags pointing at nothing, mangled umlauts, leftovers.
checkup.library_unreadable: The library could not be read in full. Whether a tag points at nothing or a taf is left over cannot be told that way, so nothing is said about it here.
checkup.missing_taf: Points at {source}, which does not exist. The box plays nothing. Record it again or empty the tag.
checkup.nameless: Plays, but has no model: no name, no cover, no sticker. Recording it again from an album gives it both.
checkup.orphan_model: No tag names this model. Its name and cover belong to nothing.
checkup.orphan_taf: No tag plays this taf ({size}). Maybe it was encoded ahead on purpose, maybe it is left over from a failed attempt.
checkup.stale: That finding was no longer current, so nothing was changed. The list below has been checked again.
error.album_gone: That album is not there any more.
error.batch_nothing_new: Every one of these albums already exists as a taf; nothing to do.
error.millimetres: Please enter two numbers in millimetres.
error.no_audio: None of those files is audio teddyCloud can encode.
error.no_cover: There is no cover image here.
error.no_language: There is no such language here.
error.no_taf_yet: That encode has not finished, so there is no taf yet.
error.no_tag: teddyCloud does not know that tag.
error.not_an_image: That is not an image name.
error.nothing_to_list: No tonie with a model to list yet.
error.parts_gone: Those parts are not known; the app may have restarted.
error.restore_gone: That restore is gone; upload the backup again.
error.title: That did not work
error.too_few_parts: {tracks} tracks do not fit in one taf: teddyCloud can jump to at most {chapters} chapters and quietly appends the rest to the last one. Choose at least {fewest} parts.
error.too_many_parts: {tracks} tracks cannot be split into {parts} parts; every part needs at least one track.
feed.entities: The feed declares XML entities, which no podcast feed needs.
feed.no_audio: The feed has no episode with audio.
feed.not_http: Only http and https addresses can be fetched, not {url}.
feed.not_public: {host} is not on the public internet ({address}).
feed.not_rss: That is not an RSS feed.
feed.sticker_reused: The sticker now plays something else ({playing}). The subscription does not overwrite it; unsubscribe or move it to another sticker.
feed.sticker_unknown: The box no longer knows this subscription's sticker.
job.podcast_done: The new episodes are on the sticker.
library.confirm_used:
This taf is played by: {used}.

After deleting it the tonie plays nothing until you give it new audio.

Delete anyway?
library.intro: The library is where teddyCloud keeps the encoded tafs, one file per tonie or part. They are made from the albums; a taf only plays once a sticker points at it.

library.summary.one: {count} taf, {size} in all. The audio the tonies point at.
library.summary.other: {count} tafs, {size} in all. The audio the tonies point at.

listening.nothing_in.one: Nothing played in the last day.
listening.nothing_in.other: Nothing played in the last {count} days.

listening.nothing_yet: Nothing recorded yet. As soon as a tonie goes on the box, it shows up here.
listening.refresh_note: Updates by itself. The box sometimes sends its log in bundles and minutes late; what it has not sent yet cannot be shown here.
listening.since: Recorded since {when}. What played before that, the app does not know.
offline.albums_work: The album list keeps working; encoding works again once teddyCloud is running.
offline.heading: teddyCloud does not answer
offline.sub: Without teddyCloud there are no tags, no models and no covers.
offline.title: Unreachable
ordering.name: file name
parts.heading: In parts
parts.intro: Each part becomes its own taf and its own tonie. They run one after another; a finished one can be put on a sticker while the next is still encoding.
parts.title: Parts
pdf.calibration_measure: Measure the centre of cross 1: it should be {left} mm from the left edge of the sheet and {top} mm from the top.
pdf.calibration_ruler: Enter the measured values on the sheet page. The line below must be exactly {length} mm long; otherwise set 100 % in the print dialog.
place.assigned: {episode} is now on this sticker. Take it off.
place.complete: Every episode already has a sticker; this one stays free.
place.failed: {episode} could not be put on this sticker.
place.prompt: Put a free sticker on the box.
place.reserved: This sticker gets {episode} as soon as the episode is encoded. Take it off.
place.taken: This sticker already plays something and stays as it is.
place.unknown: A new sticker; teddyCloud is just getting to know it. Leave it there for a moment.
podcasts.intro: A sticker that always has a podcast's newest episodes. It checks twice a day; anything new is downloaded and put on the sticker. Unlike a radio tonie it plays without a network too.
podcasts.order_hint: The newest episode comes first. Unsubscribing leaves the sticker playing what it has.
radio.differences: Two things that are different at the box.
radio.differences_text: The box creates an empty file per stream, 240 MB by default - enough for about six hours, after which it stops and the tonie has to come off and go back on. And without internet a radio tonie plays nothing at all, while a normal one carries on.
radio.intro: A tag does not have to point at a taf - it can point at a stream. The figure then plays radio while it stands on the box, and nothing has to be encoded.
radio.name: Name
radio.suggestions: Suggestions when you click into the field. Unchecked - whether a station works only the box can tell.
radio.title: Radio tonie

restore.changes.one: One change. It is listed below; confirming writes exactly that.
restore.changes.other: {count} changes. Each is listed below; confirming writes exactly these.

restore.note.library_unreadable: Library unreadable; whether the taf is there is unknown.
restore.note.log_kept: A log is already running here; it is not overwritten.
restore.note.taf_missing: The taf is still missing. The tonie stays silent until it is encoded again.
restore.note.tag_unread: The box has not read this sticker yet. Place it once, then restore again.
restore.nothing: The backup matches the current state. There is nothing to do.
sheet.back_hint: A second sticker per tonie, for the free back. It carries the name instead of the picture, so a figure can be told apart without the box. Year and playing time are on it where the app knows them; tonies from before this feature lack them.
sheet.back_tracks_hint: - what does not fit is counted
sheet.extra_hint: Pictures without a model go on the sheet once each.
sheet.heading: Traveltonies sheet
sheet.intro: A4, round 46 mm stickers, {count} per sheet. The picture is printed 1 mm past the cut line, so a cut beside it does not land on white paper.
sheet.none: No model with its own cover yet. Record a tonie first and it shows up here.
sheet.overview_hint: Every tonie on one A4 sheet: cover, name, year, playing time.
tonie.audio_on_tag: - the audio belongs to the tag, not the model.
tonie.copy_hint: A second sticker that plays the same: for the grandparents, or to replace a lost one. It gets the same audio and the same name; nothing is encoded again. A new sticker only shows up here once the box has read it.
tonie.no_model: This tag has no model of its own, so there is nothing to edit. Record it from an album and it gets a cover and track names.
tonie.no_other: The box knows no other sticker yet.
tonie.remove_hint: Deletes cover, series, episode and track names.
tonies.none: teddyCloud knows no tag yet. Hold one against the box.
tonies.note_stale: , the box has not been heard from for a while
upload.hint: For albums that are not on the server. Pictures may come along; the first one becomes the cover. A folder holding one subfolder per episode becomes several albums, set up together.
upload.title: Upload
